postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4.
The number of problems in each test case is between 1 and 10^5.
The tags of the problems are integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.
postconditions.description: The total number of problems across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

invariants.expression: a_{p_i} != a_{p_{i+1}} for all 1 <= i < n
invariants.description: No two problems with the same tag can be solved consecutively.

invariants.expression: The minimum possible cost of a permutation that satisfies the requirement.
invariants.description: The output should be the minimum possible cost of a permutation that satisfies the condition of not solving two problems with the same tag consecutively.

invariants.expression: If no permutations meet the requirement, output -1.
invariants.description: If there is no valid permutation that satisfies the condition, the output should be -1.
